evals.prompt: I need to coach [rep name] - they're one of my mid-market AEs. Can you analyze their recent calls and tell me what they need to work on? Build me a coaching plan I can use in our 1:1 next week.
evals.expected_output: A structured coaching report with competency scores from transcript analysis, specific call evidence, identified strengths and gaps, matched training courses, and suggested 1:1 questions
expectations: The skill resolves the rep name using the available user directory before searching meetings
The skill searches for meetings with has_transcript=true
At least 2 transcripts are fetched and analyzed
Each competency from the framework is scored with evidence
Talk-to-listen ratio is calculated
Strengths are identified with specific call examples
Growth areas are identified with specific call examples
Training courses or roleplays are recommended from the LMS catalog
The output includes suggested coaching questions for the 1:1
The skill asks for confirmation before assigning courses

evals.prompt: How is [rep name] doing on their calls? I noticed they've been losing deals at the negotiation stage and I want to understand why from their call recordings.
evals.expected_output: Analysis focused on identifying why deals are lost at negotiation — likely surfacing objection handling and value articulation gaps from transcripts, with targeted training recommendations
expectations: The skill resolves the rep using the available user directory
Transcripts are analyzed with special attention to objection handling and negotiation moments
The analysis connects call behaviors to deal outcomes where possible
Specific moments where the rep struggled with negotiation are cited with timestamps
Training recommendations are relevant to the identified negotiation gaps
The coaching plan addresses the specific concern about losing deals at negotiation stage

evals.prompt: I'm prepping for my 1:1s this week. Can you give me a quick coaching snapshot for each of my reps - [rep A], [rep B], and [rep C]? Just the highlights - strengths, one thing to work on, and a conversation starter for each.
evals.expected_output: Concise coaching snapshots for 3 reps — each with a strength, a growth area, and a suggested conversation opener based on transcript evidence
expectations: All three reps are resolved and analyzed
Each rep gets a distinct coaching snapshot
Each snapshot includes at least one strength with evidence
Each snapshot includes at least one growth area with evidence
Each snapshot includes a suggested conversation starter or coaching question
The output is concise and scannable — not a full report for each rep
